summary: Run selected native tests directly against a configured archive library.
details: Profiles contain small selection definitions. Migrated upgrade, progression and Library runners switch verified mod-list/settings controls under exclusive library ownership, retain private run output and restore previous controls.

The direct-library path creates no dependency copies, hard links or extracted mod directories. Unconverted native entry points refuse before staging. Checkout-local immutable custody tests remain separate from normal gameplay execution.
Exact versions, hashes and scenario definitions remain in tracked contracts; machine-specific engine and library paths are explicit local bindings. Missing inputs do not recreate retired profiles.
